textRun.content: Product Engineer & Founder · From Idea to Launch
I’m a product-minded engineer and founder who turns complex ideas into simple, useful products. I work closely with customers, shape the right solution, and take it from first idea to launch.
Tools that help software companies manage subscriptions, usage, credits, access, and payments
Built the core product for managing plans, usage, credits, access, and payments.
Took the product from idea to launch, including the customer dashboard and tools that make it easy to use.
Designed it so teams can define their own rules and run the product on their own systems.
Led three products from customer conversations and strategy through design, launch, and customer presentations.
Created products that automate work with AI, simplify attendance and identity checks, and improve everyday experiences.
Served as the main product engineer, turning unclear customer needs into clear, working products.
Moved the product to a faster, more maintainable foundation.
Created a consistent visual language and rebuilt the product experience.
Built a system that helped teams see and understand activity across major cloud platforms.
· An open-source tool that lets teams safely share work from a local computer and stay connected when networks change.
· A coding assistant that works across command line, web, and mobile, keeping conversations and workspaces connected.
· A toolkit for building AI assistants that can use tools, remember context, and work across different services.
